name: Jana Novotná
bio:
Jana's journey into motorsport PR began somewhat unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in journalism, she stumbled into an internship with a small rally team and quickly discovered a passion for the high-octane world. She thrived in the fast-paced environment, quickly mastering the art of crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations.

Over the years, Jana has honed her skills, working with various teams and drivers across different racing disciplines. She's known for her pragmatic approach, always focusing on delivering results and maintaining a positive image for her clients. At Carlin Academy, she's responsible for shaping the public perception of the team and its young drivers, ensuring they receive the recognition they deserve while navigating the pressures of the sport.

 Jana's strength lies in her ability to see the bigger picture. She's not just concerned with immediate media coverage; she focuses on building long-term relationships and crafting a sustainable brand identity. Her loyalty and dedication make her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail.
physical.description: Jana has a warm smile and a perpetually focused gaze behind her rectangular glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with story ideas and media contacts.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in her office.
Insists on having a cup of chamomile tea before any major press event.
